Keywords: Fish glue drying and composite joints
RagShortTexts: Animal glue joins components in composite objects.
Materials, drying and damp affect the joint.

Variants.Content: Animal glues, including fish glue, join components. Preparation, clean surfaces and drying affect strength. A repairer distinguishes failed glue from broken parts; damp and haste increase the risk of renewed separation.
A glued repair needs time before loading. Hasty use ruins the work; stored glue and a skilled repairer are both needed with a traveling force.
Glue buyers need craftsmen who judge suitability. Overstocking without proper keeping wastes money; scheduled repair time saves more material than repeated demands for speed.
Glue work consumes vessels, fuel and attention. A failed batch wastes materials; repairers inspect load and damp exposure before rejoining or replacing parts.
